units.source_text: 我们父子拜谒金阁之后，再次返回大雄宝殿的正门，

en.t: After my father and I had paid our respects at the Golden Pavilion, we returned once more to the main gate of the Great Hero Hall,

units.source_text: 我们被引领穿过宽敞的长廊，

en.t: and were led through a spacious long corridor,

units.source_text: 来到了可以展望著名的陆舟松的庭院——大书院的住持房间。

en.t: arriving at the abbot's room in the Great Study, which looked out over the garden with the famous Rikushu pine.
